messages:
sara: FYI seeing a sudden nvme write latency spike in us-west2 that's stalling GPU attaches. backlog up ~7% in 10m :confused:
infra-bot: [ALERT] region=us-west2 metric=nvme_write_latency threshold=25ms impacted_nodes=7
mike: are these kubelet attach timeouts or lower-level block errors? any CRC or firmware hints?
sara: mostly kubelet attach timeouts + some nvme CRC warnings in dmesg. affected: gnode-uw2-12/13/19/21/23/34/45
jessica: hmm. saw a similar transient last month when janitor concurrency hit the cohort. can we throttle cleaner waves for that label?
sara: applying a conservative change now: set CLEANER_CONCURRENCY=5 for nodes with label ephemeral=hot in us-west2. rolling update across 7 nodes
mike: paste the command so I can replicate in eu-west if needed
sara: ran:
```
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ephemeral-cleaner CLEANER_CONCURRENCY=5 --context=us-west2
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ephemeral-cleaner MAX_DELETE_BYTES=1073741824 --context=us-west2
```
leo: cost heads-up: if attaches keep failing we might run ~40-60 idle gpu-minutes per hour. tag me before any cross-region rebalancing request :eyes:
jessica: good. also set a soft backoff so cleaner gives precedence to attach-critical ops. filing an action item to add attach-sensitivity flag to the cleaner
mike: lowering max_delete_bytes helps since big deletions caused write bursts previously. monitoring iops now
infra-bot: [METRIC] us-west2 nvme_write_latency: 1m=31ms 5m=26ms 15m=14ms
sara: after change 1st wave latency dropped from 32ms -> 18ms across the cohort. attach backlog decreasing
jessica: estimate risk window? if the cleaner job backlog resumes we should have automatic throttles or fail-open for attach paths
mike: ballpark 30-90m to clear current backlog. if we see tail latency >30ms after 1h we escalate to rebalancing or temporary capacity holdbacks
leo: agree. please capture GPU-minute delta and update ticket. I'll review any rebalancing ask
sara: filed INFRA-1298 "cleaner: attach-aware priority + throttles" assigned to eng-infra owners jessica/mike/sara. adding logs and graphs to the ticket
jessica: postmortem items: (1) cleaner should respect an attach-priority semaphore, (2) metric alerting needs a higher-sensitivity runbook, (3) add a canary to cleaner env changes
mike: adding an automated rollback patch if latency worsens after changes (will create deployment with canary=2 nodes)
sara: current status: nvme write latency 1m avg 18ms, attach backlog trending down. will monitor for 60m and then close the incident thread unless it regresses
leo: thanks team :thumbsup:
 jessica: nice catch and quick mitigation :rocket:
sara: ack, closing unless we see more spikes
